segments.thig15.1:2.1: Isidāsī tattha ekā, dutiyā bodhīti sīlasampannā ca;
segments.thig15.1:3.1: Tā piṇḍāya caritvā, bhattatthaṃ [bhattattaṃ (sī.)] kariya dhotapattāyo;
segments.thig15.1:6.3: Tassamhi ekadhītā, piyā manāpā ca dayitā ca.
segments.thig15.1:7.3: Seṭṭhī pahūtaratano, tassa mamaṃ suṇhamadāsi tāto.
segments.thig15.1:8.3: Sirasā karomi pāde, vandāmi yathāmhi anusiṭṭhā.
segments.thig15.1:9.1: “Yā mayhaṃ sāmikassa, bhaginiyo bhātuno parijano vā;
segments.thig15.1:10.1: “Annena ca pānena ca, khajjena ca yañca tattha sannihitaṃ;
segments.thig15.1:10.3: Chādemi upanayāmi ca, demi ca yaṃ yassa patirūpaṃ.
segments.thig15.1:11.1: “Kālena upaṭṭhahitvā [uṭṭhahitvā (syā. ka.), upaṭṭhahituṃ (?)], gharaṃ samupagamāmi ummāre;
segments.thig15.1:15.3: Isidāsiyā na saha vacchaṃ, ekāgārehaṃ [ekagharepa’ haṃ (?)] saha vatthuṃ’.
segments.thig15.1:16.1: “‘Mā evaṃ putta avaca, isidāsī paṇḍitā paribyattā;
segments.thig15.1:16.3: Uṭṭhāyikā analasā, kiṃ tuyhaṃ na rocate putta’.
segments.thig15.1:17.1: “‘Na ca me hiṃsati kiñci, na cahaṃ isidāsiyā saha vacchaṃ;
segments.thig15.1:17.3: Dessāva me alaṃ me, apucchāhaṃ [āpucchāhaṃ (syā.), āpucchahaṃ-nāpucchahaṃ (?)] gamissāmi’.
segments.thig15.1:18.1: “Tassa vacanaṃ suṇitvā, sassu sasuro ca maṃ apucchiṃsu;
segments.thig15.1:19.1: “‘Napihaṃ aparajjhaṃ kiñci, napi hiṃsemi na bhaṇāmi dubbacanaṃ;
segments.thig15.1:19.3: Kiṃ sakkā kātuyye, yaṃ maṃ viddessate bhattā’.
segments.thig15.1:20.1: “Te maṃ pitugharaṃ paṭinayiṃsu, vimanā dukhena adhibhūtā;
segments.thig15.1:21.1: “Atha maṃ adāsi tāto, aḍḍhassa gharamhi dutiyakulikassa;
segments.thig15.1:21.3: Tato upaḍḍhasuṅkena, yena maṃ vindatha seṭṭhi.
segments.thig15.1:22.1: “Tassapi gharamhi māsaṃ, avasiṃ atha sopi maṃ paṭiccharayi [paṭicchasi (sī. ka.), paṭicchati (syā.), paṭiccharati (ka.)];
segments.thig15.1:23.1: “Bhikkhāya ca vicarantaṃ, damakaṃ dantaṃ me pitā bhaṇati;
segments.thig15.1:23.3: ‘Hohisi [sohisi (sabbattha)] me jāmātā, nikkhipa poṭṭhiñca [pontiṃ (sī. syā.)] ghaṭikañca’.
segments.thig15.1:24.1: “Sopi vasitvā pakkhaṃ [pakkamatha (sī.)], atha tātaṃ bhaṇati ‘dehi me poṭṭhiṃ;
segments.thig15.1:25.1: “Atha naṃ bhaṇatī tāto, ammā sabbo ca me ñātigaṇavaggo;
segments.thig15.1:25.3: ‘Kiṃ te na kīrati idha, bhaṇa khippaṃ taṃ te karihi’ti.
segments.thig15.1:26.1: “Evaṃ bhaṇito bhaṇati,‘yadi me attā sakkoti alaṃ mayhaṃ;
segments.thig15.1:26.3: Isidāsiyā na saha vacchaṃ, ekagharehaṃ saha vatthuṃ’.
segments.thig15.1:27.3: ‘Āpucchitūna gacchaṃ, marituye [maritāye (sī.), marituṃ (syā.)] vā pabbajissaṃ vā’.
segments.thig15.1:30.1: “Annena ca pānena ca, khajjena ca yañca tattha sannihitaṃ;
segments.thig15.1:31.1: “Atha maṃ bhaṇatī tāto,‘idheva puttaka [puttike (syā. ka.)] carāhi tvaṃ dhammaṃ;
segments.thig15.1:31.3: Annena ca pānena ca, tappaya samaṇe dvijātī ca’.
segments.thig15.1:35.3: Taṃ tava ācikkhissaṃ, taṃ ekamanā nisāmehi.
segments.thig15.1:37.3: Pakko tato ca uṭṭhahitvā, makkaṭiyā kucchimokkamiṃ.
segments.thig15.1:39.3: Kāṇāya ca khañjāya ca, eḷakiyā kucchimokkamiṃ.
segments.thig15.1:42.1: “Voḍhūna [te puna (syā. ka.), vodhuna (ka. aṭṭha.)] naṅgalamahaṃ, sakaṭañca dhārayāmi;
segments.thig15.1:43.1: “Sohaṃ tato cavitvā, vīthiyā dāsiyā ghare jāto;
segments.thig15.1:43.3: Neva mahilā na puriso, yathāpi gantvāna paradāraṃ.
segments.thig15.1:44.3: Kapaṇamhi appabhoge, dhanika [aṇika (aṭṭha.), taṃsaṃvaṇṇanāyampi atthayutti gavesitabbā] purisapātabahulamhi.
segments.thig15.1:45.1: “Taṃ maṃ tato satthavāho, ussannāya vipulāya vaḍḍhiyā;
segments.thig15.1:46.1: “Atha soḷasame vasse, disvā maṃ pattayobbanaṃ kaññaṃ;
segments.thig15.1:47.1: “Tassapi aññā bhariyā, sīlavatī guṇavatī yasavatī ca;
segments.thig15.1:48.3: Dāsīva upaṭṭhahantiṃ, tassapi anto kato mayā”ti.

lines: Napihaṃ aparajjhanti napi ahaṃ tassa kiñci aparajjhiṃ.
Kiṃ sakkā kātuyyeti kiṃ mayā kātuṃ ayye sakkā.
Yaṃ maṃ viddessate bhattāti yasmā akāraṇeneva bhattā mayhaṃ viddessate viddessaṃ cittappakopaṃ karoti.
Puttamanurakkhamānāti attano puttaṃ mayhaṃ sāmikaṃ cittamanurakkhaṇena anurakkhantā.
Jitāmhase rūpiniṃ lakkhinti jitā amhase jitā vatāmha rūpavatiṃ siriṃ, manussavesena carantiyā siridevatāya parihīnā vatāti attho.
Aḍḍhassa gharamhi dutiyakulikassāti paṭhamasāmikaṃ upādāya dutiyassa aḍḍhassa kulaputtassa gharamhi maṃ adāsi, dento ca tato paṭhamasuṅkato upaḍḍhasuṅkena adāsi.
Yena maṃ vindatha seṭṭhīti yena suṅkena maṃ paṭhamaṃ seṭṭhi vindatha paṭilabhi, tato upaḍḍhasuṅkenāti yojanā.
Maṃ paṭiccharayīti maṃ nīhari, so maṃ gehato nikkaḍḍhi.
Yathā pare kiñci dassanti, evaṃ attano kāyaṃ vācañca dantaṃ vūpasantaṃ katvā paradattabhikkhāya vicaraṇakaṃ.
Nikkhipa poṭṭhiñca ghaṭikañcāti tayā paridahitaṃ pilotikākhaṇḍañca bhikkhākapālañca chaḍḍehi.
Sopi vasitvā pakkhanti sopi bhikkhako puriso mayā saddhiṃ addhamāsamattaṃ vasitvā pakkāmi.
Atha naṃ bhaṇatī tātoti taṃ bhikkhakaṃ mama pitā mātā sabbo ca me ñātigaṇo vaggavaggo hutvā bhaṇati.
Kiṃ te na kīrati idha tuyhaṃ kiṃ nāma na kirati na sādhiyati, bhaṇa khippaṃ.
Yadi me attā sakkotīti yadi mayhaṃ attā attādhīno bhujisso ca hoti, alaṃ mayhaṃ isidāsiyā tāya payojanaṃ natthi, tasmā na saha vacchaṃ na saha vasissaṃ, ekaghare ahaṃ tāya saha vatthunti yojanā.
Vissajjito gato soti so bhikkhako pitarā vissajjito yathāruci gato.
Uṭṭhāyāsanaṃ tassā paññāpayinti uṭṭhahitvā āsanaṃ tassā theriyā paññāpesiṃ.
Carāhi tvaṃ dhammanti tvaṃ pabbajitvā caritabbaṃ brahmacariyādidhammaṃ cara.
Yaṃ sacchikarī dvipadaseṭṭhoti yaṃ maggaphalanibbānasaññitaṃ lokuttaradhammaṃ dvipadānaṃ seṭṭho sammāsambuddho sacchi akāsi, taṃ labhassūti yojanā.
Yassayaṃ phalavipākoti yassa pāpakammassa, ayaṃ sāmikassa amanāpabhāvasaṅkhāto nissandaphalabhūto vipāko.
Taṃ tava ācikkhissanti taṃ kammaṃ tava kathessāmi.
Tanti ācikkhiyamānaṃ tameva kammaṃ, taṃ vā mama vacanaṃ.
So paradāraṃ asevihanti so ahaṃ parassa dāraṃ aseviṃ.
Tato ca uṭṭhahitvāti tato nirayato vuṭṭhito cuto.
Tassetaṃ kammaphalanti tassa mayhaṃ etaṃ atīte katassa kammassa phalaṃ.
Yathāpi gantvāna paradāranti yathā taṃ paradāraṃ atikkamitvā.
Neva mahilā na purisoti itthīpi purisopi na homi, jātinapuṃsakoti attho.
Dhanikapurisapātabahulamhīti iṇāyikānaṃ purisānaṃ adhipatanabahule bahūhi iṇāyikehi abhibhavitabbe.
Orundhatassa puttoti assa satthavāhassa putto, mayi paṭibaddhacitto nāmena giridāso nāma avarundhati attano pariggahabhāvena gehe karoti.
Tassāhaṃ viddesanamakāsinti tassa bhattuno taṃ bhariyaṃ sapattiṃ viddesanakammaṃ akāsiṃ.
Yathā taṃ so kujjhati, evaṃ paṭipajjiṃ.
Yaṃ maṃ apakīritūna gacchantīti yaṃ dāsī viya sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭhahantiṃ maṃ tattha tattha patino apakiritvā chaḍḍetvā anapekkhā apagacchanti.
Etaṃ tassā mayhaṃ tadā katassa paradārikakammassa sapattiṃ viddesanakammassa ca nissandaphalaṃ.
Tassapi anto kato mayāti tassapi tathā anunayapāpakakammassa dāruṇassa pariyanto idāni mayā aggamaggaṃ adhigacchantiyā kato, ito paraṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ natthīti.
Yaṃ panettha antarantarā na vibhattaṃ, taṃ vuttanayattā uttānatthameva.
